name: Dustwind Cave
summary: High above Razorwind Canyon, Burning Blade initiates train in Dustwind Cave, northeast of Razor Hill. The cave shelters the cult as well as its training ground in Durotar.

sections.title: A Shadow in the Cliffs
sections.body: Dustwind Cave looks down on Razorwind Canyon, close to Razor Hill and a danger to the town. Here, the Burning Blade trains recruits beyond the notice of Horde authorities. Cultists teach forbidden dark magic and demonology, preparing initiates to weaken the young orcish realm from within Durotar's borders.

sections.title: Tainted Bloodlines
sections.body: Those who enter Dustwind Cave risk the Burning Blade's corruptions. Cultists wield volatile dark arts, including felblood afflictions. Their work shows the cult's hold on the demonic legacy Thrall fought to banish. Clearing the cabal from the cave matters to Durotar's fragile peace.

faq.answer: Dustwind Cave lies high on the clifftops of Razorwind Canyon, northeast of Razor Hill in Durotar.
Burning Blade cultists and initiates occupy Dustwind Cave. The demonic cult spreads fel corruption and seeks to destabilize the Horde.

faq.q: Why is the Burning Blade operating here?
aliases: why are cultists in dustwind cave
faq.answer: The Burning Blade uses Dustwind Cave as a secluded training outpost. Seasoned cultists teach new recruits demonic arts beyond the immediate gaze of guards in Orgrimmar and Razor Hill.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want this cave cleared?
faq.answer: Demon-worshiping cultists near Razor Hill threaten traveling recruits and Durotar's defenses.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you may recognize the dark rituals in Dustwind Cave. The Burning Blade turns its fel gifts against Thrall's new order.
For the Horde, Dustwind Cave is a dangerous breach within your borders. It shelters demon cultists within shouting distance of Razor Hill.
